title: Waited time stops at the end of an ended run
lead: s411 shows how long a waiting step has waited, measured from `waiting_since` to now. A run ended without `--close-steps` can leave a step in `wait`, and the board and `relay-run list` keep counting that wait after the run ended.
findings_note: s411 review 2026-10-30, later note: a step left in wait by relay-run end without --close-steps keeps counting its wait up to now
boundary: **Not in this slice:** closing waiting steps automatically at `end`; changing `waiting_since`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: On the board's recently ended runs, a wait that stopped when the run ended reads as still growing, which misleads the owner about what is waiting now.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli_relay.py`: `_step_line` (the `waiting_since` elapsed text) measures to `relayrun.utcnow()`; it takes the run and uses `Run.clock`. (The slice named `cli.py` lines 687-688; the function is in `cli_relay.py`.)
- `src/slicer/relayrun.py`: `Run.clock(now)`, the run's last event stamp when ended, else `now`.
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: `_waiting_cells` measures to `now`; `board_lines` draws an ended run as one `_ended_line`, so no wait cell shows for it and nothing changes here.
- `tests/test_relay_run.py`: an ended run with a waiting step.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `test_Wait_EndedRun_WaitTimeStopsAtTheEnd`: a run ended without `--close-steps` with a step in `wait`; `relay-run list` text shows the wait up to the end stamp, not to now. It fails today.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `Run.clock(now)` returns the run's last event stamp when the run is ended, else now.
2. `_step_line` in `src/slicer/cli_relay.py` takes the run and passes `run.clock(relayrun.utcnow())` to `relayrun.elapsed_text`. `tui.py` does not change: `board_lines` draws an ended run as one `_ended_line` and never calls `_waiting_cells` for it, so the board has no wait cell to stop.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch.
